premises.text: 3D printing is revolutionizing various industries and is a growing market
premises.evidence_span: 3D printing is revolutionizing medicine, architecture, and even the military. 3D printing is a billion-dollar market now and is expected to triple in five years.

premises.text: Designers can sell professional-level 3D printable files through a marketplace
premises.evidence_span: creating a marketplace where designers can sell professional-level 3D printable files, rather than just giving them away on sites like Thingiverse.

premises.text: Consumers can customize and order 3D printed products conveniently
premises.evidence_span: With 3DLT, it's built right in. To customize, you'll just enter in your size and width, and voila, custom stilettos fitted perfectly for you.

premises.text: 3DLT generates revenue from design sales and profits from print sales
premises.evidence_span: In our business model, we generate revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print.

premises.text: 3D printing will shift from prototyping to finished products in the near future
premises.evidence_span: Today, 70% of 3D print is for prototyping and industrial use. But by 2020, the model will flip. And 80%, or over 4 billion, will be consumed as finished product.

premises.text: 3DLT provides consumers with more choice and lower prices through competition
premises.evidence_span: Our system allows 3D printers to compete for your business. With competition comes commoditization, and that means lower pricing for you.

value.text: Consumers gain access to a wide variety of customizable 3D printed products
value.evidence_span: everyone, from your grandmother to your grandson, can find and buy designs on 3DLT.

notes: No separate premises for the mention of 70,000 3D printers as it supports the growth claim.
